'''Kala'uun''' was a large subterranean [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], within the [[Lonely Five Range|Lonely Five]] mountain range, and one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] two [[Capital/Legends|capitals]]. Like all cities on Ryloth, it was located along the twilight terminator separating day from night. It had a [[Kala'uun Starport|large spaceport]] operated by the [[Clan Shak|Shak Clan,]] that was the center of interplanetary commerce for the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]]. To protect it from [[heat storm]]s and the native [[Lylek/Legends|lylek]], a massive portcullis blocks the only accessible underground tunnel to the city.

[[File:KalauunPortcullis-PlattsStarportGuide.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Portcullis entrance to Kala'uun (including [[Kala'uun Starport]])]]
The upper layers of the city hosted shops, tourist attractions, schools, and business opportunities that drew visitors from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Two large businesses centered in Kala'uun were [[Galactic Exotics]] and [[Schaum/Yfarg/Welbig/Fabrico and Associates|SchaumAssoc]].

The lower levels were rarely seen by visitors. These levels mainly featured residential areas and shops catering to residents. The largest and most opulent houses were located closest to the surface, spanning for a little more than a kilometer. Below them were more modest housing and excellent restaurants serving authentic Twi'lek food.

At the very bottom and side caverns were where slums were located. Here the poorest Twi'leks tended to [[Rycrit/Legends|Rycrit]] cattle and raised algae for a living. Visitors were not allowed to enter the lower levels unless they had a special pass or were accompanied by a resident.

Kala'uun also contained [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] dens, where [[Alema Rar]] spent her youth dancing. The [[Star of Kala'unn]], a valuable jewel that was important in Twi'lek culture, was named after the city.

One hundred thousand [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] lived in Kala'unn during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
